[[File:Saberdart-FF72.png|thumb|right|250px|A Mk I Saberdart]]
A '''dart''' was a type projectile that was usually fired from a [[Dart shooter|dart shooting]] weapon. Many darts were filled with a contact [[Poison/Legends|poison]] to create a [[Poison dart/Legends|poison dart]] designed to incapacitate or even kill a target, such as the lethal [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|Kamino saberdart]].

==Description==
Darts used as ammunition in [[dart shooter]]s were generally less than five [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long, and could be either solid or hollow. The construction material varied, and the darts could be made of many different types of metals and [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]]. The hollow darts could be loaded with a variety of compounds, such as [[Malkite themfar/Legends|Malkite themfar]], [[Fex-M3/Legends|Fex-M3]], [[symoxin]], [[molecular acid]], and even [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
